<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="living-wyverns" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Living Wyverns</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Wyverns are one of the 4 raptor mobs, and are known for their unique environmental effects and highly damaging attacks. They offer decent </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP, and are a consistent source of GP due to their wyvern bone drops.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The Dragon slayer perk and sigil </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689502927731163170.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayerperk" title="dragonslayerperk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641339921814126594.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayer" title="dragonslayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, along with any other dragon-slaying related items such as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, do </nowiki><strong><nowiki>NOT</nowiki></strong><nowiki> work on wyverns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill : 1878.8</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~700 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (ALL AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour : ~1.3M </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (ALL AFK)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Use this tile for all styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/MJ1aIsrsJN.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Wyverns have a rich drop table with a guaranteed drop of Wyvern bones, a valuable item and an ingredient for super prayer potions.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For the Slayer collection log, Wyverns are also killed for their unique drop, the Wyvern Crossbow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580177522587729940.png?v=1" alt="wyverncrossbow" title="wyverncrossbow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, a T85 crossbow dropped at a rate of 1/2000 on task (1/10,000 off-task).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Living Wyverns are found in 2 locations:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><nowiki>The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, accessed via a rope in the south of the Skeletal Wyvern room.</nowiki></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. The easiest way to get there would be via dungeoneering cape teleport </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/976732922545586246.png?v=1" alt="dgcape" title="dgcape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to the Frost dragon dungeon (0,8)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<ol><nowiki>
</nowiki><li><strong><nowiki>Northwest of Ghorrock, accessed via the Ghorrock teleport (ancient spellbook)</nowiki></strong></li><nowiki>
</nowiki></ol>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. This is the best location as it benefits from the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Wyverns are also attackable from areas without the chill mechanic, making it viable to be stationary and AFK in this location.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Wyrm breath</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Wyverns have a breath attack different from that of dragons, and requires </nowiki><strong><nowiki>wyrmfire</nowiki></strong><nowiki> protection.
    • Use wyrmfire potions or elder overload salves to block all damage from this attack.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Cavern chill</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Wyverns reside in a habitat which slowly increases the player's cold percentage.
    • The higher the chill percentage, the lower the poison damage taken by the player. No poison damage will be taken by players with ~70% chill.
    • At ≥25% chill, wyvern attack damage increases to 2500 from around 1300.
    • At ≥90% chill, players will be periodically stunned at 8-10s per stun, </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Never let your chill reach this stage.</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
    • Fires throughout the wyvern habitats and be lit, standing within 2 tiles of them periodically lowers the player's chill percentage.
    • </nowiki><strong><nowiki>This mechanic is avoided completely by standing outside of area affected by cavern chill in the wilderness.</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Wyrm poison</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Wyverns can inflict poison damage based on the percentage of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Cavern chill</nowiki></strong><nowiki> every 4-5 ticks.
    • Antipoison++ halves the damage, but every tick of poison decreases potion duration.
    • </nowiki><strong><nowiki>This mechanic is avoided completely by standing outside of area affected by cavern chill in the wilderness.</nowiki></strong><nowiki>
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Varied attacking</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Wyverns can attack with all 3 styles, alongside their breath attack.
    • They will attack with primarily </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if the player stands in melee range.
    • Hence, either stand in melee distance and use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or camp </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and out heal their damage through high DPS.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>



</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Items</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Elder_overload_salve#(6) <strong><nowiki>Elder overload salve</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • By far the best potion to use here due to its wyrmfire protection.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Bonecrusher#Bonecrusher_upgrade <strong><nowiki>Upgraded bonecrusher</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344526602240.png?v=1" alt="bonecrusher" title="bonecrusher" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Useful for gathering wyvern bones, in combination with Death Note </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150755093426216.png?v=1" alt="deathnote" title="deathnote" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
⬥</nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Underworld_Grimoire_2 <strong><nowiki>Underworld Grimoire 2/3/4</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1" alt="underworldgrimoire4" title="underworldgrimoire4" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Very useful for sending wyvern bones to storage as soon as they're dropped.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Passive unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Stone_of_Jas_(status) <strong><nowiki>Stone of Jas buff</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1006121672790773770.png?v=1" alt="jasboost" title="jasboost" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Provides a 5% damage increase against living wyverns in the wilderness.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Infernal_Puzzle_Box <strong><nowiki>Infernal Puzzle box</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994189299681607800.png?v=1" alt="infernalpuzzlebox" title="infernalpuzzlebox" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Provides a 9% damage increase and 14% damage reduction in the wilderness at max rank.
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
</div>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Upkeep </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809209782698024.png?v=1" alt="darkness" title="darkness" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1266417822188437569.png?v=1" alt="scriptureofamascut" title="scriptureofamascut" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489341984779.png?v=1" alt="kwuarmsticks" title="kwuarmsticks" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at all times.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use Totem of Vitality </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507594811670538.png?v=1" alt="vitalitytotem" title="vitalitytotem" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Boon of Het HP boosts.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required if using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1274331251301683260.png?v=1" alt="underworldgrimoire4" title="underworldgrimoire4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Legendary pet.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to help aggro the Living Wyverns.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="active-strategy"><nowiki>Active Strategy</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If doing them actively with best-in-slot gear, stand close to the most north-western fire in the wilderness spot (refer to example vod), and use target cycle to target wyverns within range. Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> whenever </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is used along with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if available.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257440278512537740.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> combos opportunistically on any wyverns that wander close to each other.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ When eating solid food, such as sharks dropped by wyverns, try to eat them in the tick between the end of a kill and the start of the next kill when you have no target, as this does not reduce adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If doing wyverns with lesser gear, an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may be used to aggro a limited amount (2-3) of wyverns which makes it more manageable to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, as shown </nowiki>[https://youtu.be/2jCihwc-Bd0 <nowiki>here</nowiki>]</p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This bar should be used only for AFKing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/486Vn8Cvym.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
